memories.content: [Context Note] Similar tasks have benefited from explicitly confirming standard radiological orientation when laterality matters, and from mapping imaging findings to the option space in the reasoning. One approach that worked was querying the anatomical side and location of the finding rather than the finding itself when options differ only by laterality.

metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?

metadata.retrieval_focus: Distinguishing between left and right anatomical findings in medical imaging by comparing symmetric structures and identifying laterality cues; handling binary choice options where the key differentiator is spatial location.
